title: myrobalanus macroptera
intro: Myrobalanus macroptera, commonly known as the Indian berry or Terminalia chebula, is a plant species belonging to the Combretaceae family. It has been used in traditional Ayurvedic medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The plant's therapeutic actions include treating digestive issues, respiratory problems, and skin conditions due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Myrobalanus macroptera include alkaloids, glycosides, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
